subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II coverage letter + PO timing for renewal/expansion
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@horizonpay.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: HorizonPay Procurement <procurement@horizonpay.com>
Date: Fri, 9 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + coverage letter needed ahead of renewal/PO

Hi Priya / Aditya,

Quick note from procurement — HorizonPay is preparing a renewal + expansion PO for Redwood (expected effective 2025-06-15). Before we can finalize, legal needs the latest SOC 2 Type II report and an interim coverage/bridge letter that confirms audit coverage between the current Type II period and the next report. Specifically they asked:

- Copy of the full SOC 2 Type II report we can share with HorizonPay legal (redactions ok).
- A bridge or interim coverage letter stating the audited period and what coverage we will provide until the next Type II is available.
- Confirmation of the latest audit period dates (start / end) and the expected date for the next Type II delivery.
- Any PO cutoff / contract start constraints (if the audit window affects procurements that start before the next report).

Timeline: procurement would like docs by end of week (2025-05-16) to keep the PO on track for the 2025-06-15 commencement. Can you confirm what you can provide and whether a bridge letter is available?

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Senior Procurement Manager
HorizonPay Inc.
[HorizonPay Procurement | procurement@horizonpay.com]

Samantha — thanks for the clear ask, we can support. High-level plan:

1) I will coordinate delivery of the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and a draft bridge letter.
2) Marissa (Security) will confirm the exact audited period and sign-off language for the bridge.
3) Aditya will sync on PO timing and commercial alignment; Dev will review any legal constraints for the requested MSA/PO dates.

Couple quick clarifying questions so we ship exactly what you need:
- Is HorizonPay ok with a redacted Type II (control-level redactions only) or do you need the full unredacted report?
- Does legal require the bridge letter to be on letterhead and signed by your security contact, or is an emailed signed PDF acceptable?

We expect to have a draft bridge letter and the report stub to you by EOD 2025-05-12, and a signed letter (if required) by 2025-05-15. If HorizonPay needs it sooner, let us know and we’ll prioritize.

— Priya

On Fri, May 9, 2025 at 9:12 AM Samantha Li <samantha.li@horizonpay.com> wrote:
> Quick note from procurement — HorizonPay is preparing a renewal + expansion PO for Redwood (expected effective 2025-06-15). Before we can finalize, legal needs the latest SOC 2 Type II report and an interim coverage/bridge letter that confirms audit coverage between the current Type II period and the next report.

Hi Samantha — thanks for the details. Per our records the most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30 (Type II). The next scheduled Type II is targeted for delivery by 2026-06-30 pending completion of fieldwork.

To bridge the gap for procurements that begin prior to the next Type II, we can provide a dated interim coverage letter on Redwood Inference letterhead summarizing:
- The last audited period: 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30 (Type II)
- That controls applicable to the Trust Services Criteria remained in place through the date of the letter
- Expected delivery window for the next Type II: Q2 2026 (target 2026-06-30)

We will provide a signed PDF of the bridge letter for HorizonPay legal. Note two practical items:
1) We cannot state future audit outcomes — the bridge letter confirms continuity of controls and the audit schedule only; it does not substitute for a completed Type II.
2) If HorizonPay requires contractual language that conditions the entire PO on an issued Type II report, our legal team needs to review the MSA redlines you shared (we received horizonpay_msa_redlines.docx).

I’m attaching the draft bridge letter (filled with the dates above) and a redacted copy of the SOC 2 Type II report for sharing with legal. Please advise if your legal needs further redactions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_2024-07_2025-06.pdf (PDF, 3.8 MB)]
[Attachment: bridge_letter_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)]

Marissa / team — thanks, this is exactly what we needed. A couple quick items from legal/procurement after reviewing the draft:

- Redacted copy of the Type II is fine.
- The bridge letter language looks good; legal asked that Redwood confirm signatory name and title for the signed PDF — can you confirm who will sign?
- Procurement requests that the signed bridge letter be dated within 30 days of the PO issuance. We expect to issue the PO by 2025-06-01 (to align billing and procurement cycles). Can you sign and return a dated PDF no earlier than 2025-05-30 and no later than 2025-06-02?
- Please send a DocuSign link for the signed bridge letter if possible (preferred).

If those timing windows work, we will proceed with the internal approvals and aim to get the PO to you the first week of June.

Thanks again — Samantha
